items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 6 at 9:22AM AKDT until July 8 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The National Weather Service in Fairbanks has issued a Red Flag
Warning for lightning, which is in effect from 10 AM Tuesday to
midnight AKDT Tuesday night.

Valley.

items.areas: Interior Seward Peninsula; Middle Yukon Valley
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 6 at 5:52AM AKDT until July 6 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds increasing to 20 to 30 mph with frequent
gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka, City and Borough of Wrangell,
Ketchikan Gateway Borough, Prince of Wales Island, Western
Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: City and Borough of Sitka; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; Prince of Wales Island; City and Borough of Wrangell; Ketchikan Gateway Borough
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel by boat or aircraft a bit more
difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 5 at 1:10PM AKDT until July 8 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Tuesday to 11 PM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High temperatures near 85 degrees expected
Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons and evenings. The warmest
temperatures are expected between 1pm and 10pm.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

Take extra precautions when working in the sun. Wear sunscreen and
lightweight, loose fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous
activities to early morning or evening. Take action when you see
symptoms of heat exh
